The full competition journey

More than a deck.
A case-prep toolkit.

Explore the jobs a competition team needs to do—from understanding the brief to answering the final judge question. This V3 map separates the local demo from capabilities still to build.

01 · UNDERSTAND THE ASK

Turn the brief into a decision.

Find the decision-maker, objective, constraints, stakeholders and the real question hidden inside the case. Keep facts supplied in the brief separate from your team’s assumptions.

Designed for the work behind a case win

Hands-on case tools

Work the numbers.
Practise the pressure.

Use these original, browser-only tools to practise sizing, unit economics and pitch timing. Calculations are only as sound as your inputs; no research is fetched or verified.

01 · MARKET SIZING

Build a simple market estimate

Start with an addressable population, narrow it to the target segment, then estimate annual spend.

Enter assumptions to calculate an illustrative serviceable market.
Formula: population × target share × annual spend. Not researched market data.
02 · UNIT ECONOMICS

See the break-even logic

Check contribution per unit and the volume needed to cover a monthly fixed-cost base.

Add your assumptions to see the contribution and break-even volume.
Excludes taxes, working capital and other costs. Validate assumptions independently.
03 · ORIGINAL MINI CASE DRILL

Choose the next best test

A meal-kit pilot has high first-order conversion but weak repeat purchase. Which first analysis best tests whether to expand?

Pick an answer to see the reasoning.
Practice 1 of 3
04 · REHEARSAL TIMER

Practise to the clock

Set your team's presentation length and run a simple rehearsal timer.

07:00
